What causes scour around bridge piers?
The swirling water turning downwards in front of the pier scours the bed
The vortex around the pier digs a funnel in the bed; if it reaches the foundation, the pier settles or tilts – the most common cause of bridge collapses.
Why is a leaking water pipe next to a building dangerous?
The escaping water carries away the soil, and a cavity grows under the footing or the surfacing
Because it increases the strength of the soil
The leaking water washes out the soil invisibly; the surfacing bridges the cavity for a while, then suddenly collapses.
Which soil is the most prone to erosion?
Flowing water easily tears out fine, cohesionless grains; cohesive soil is protected by cohesion, gravel by the weight of its grains.
